'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[2021 Afghanistan attacks]]
***Three [[Afghan National Army|Afghan soldiers]] are killed and four others are wounded in an attack on their vehicle by unidentified gunmen in [[Herat Province]]. [https://tolonews.com/afghanistan-169375 (Tolo News)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*Events affected by the COVID-19 pandemic, [[COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland]]
**[[Dublin]] cancels their annual [[Saint Patrick's Day]] festival for the second year due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]]. The event will instead be held virtually on a special online TV channel. [https://www.rte.ie/news/2021/0120/1190884-st-patricks-festival/ (RTÉ)]
**[[Cork (city)|Cork]], [[Limerick]], and [[Ennis]] have all cancelled their respective [[Saint Patrick's Day]] [[parade|parades]] for the second year due to the COVID-19 pandemic. [https://www.rte.ie/news/munster/2021/0120/1191023-st-patricks-day-parades/ (RTÉ)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 Madrid explosion]]
**An explosion caused by a [[gas leak]] at a residence for priests in [[Madrid]], [[Spain]] results in four fatalities and injures ten others. It also partially destroys the residence. [https://www.reuters.com/article/BigStory12/idUSKBN29P1SU (Reuters)]
*A boat carrying migrants from [[West Africa]] [[capsize]]s in the [[Mediterranean Sea]] off the coast of [[Libya]], resulting in 43 fatalities. [https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20210120-at-least-43-african-migrants-drown-off-libya-un-agencies-say (France 24)]
*An explosion caused by coal dust and air in a [[thermal power plant]] in [[Angren, Uzbekistan|Angren]], [[Uzbekistan]] kills three workers and leaves three others injured. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2021-01/20/c_139684397.htm (Xinhua)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands]]
****The [[Netherlands]] bans all flights from the [[United Kingdom]], [[South Africa]] and all [[South America]]n countries beginning January 23 in order to reduce the spread of more contagious [[Variants of SARS-CoV-2|variants of SARS-CoV-2]]. [https://nltimes.nl/2021/01/20/rutte-curfew-undesirable-needed-netherlands-ban-flights-uk (''NL Times'')]
****[[Prime Minister of the Netherlands|Prime Minister]] [[Mark Rutte]] issues a statement that would ask the [[States General of the Netherlands|parliament]] to vote regarding a weekend curfew from 8.30 p.m. to 4.30 a.m. in a parliamentary debate that will begin tomorrow. [https://www.dutchnews.nl/news/2021/01/curfew-on-the-cards-for-this-weekend-no-flights-from-uk-or-south-africa/ (Dutch News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Andorra]]
****[[Andorra]] begins its [[vaccination]] campaign against [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://www.elperiodic.ad/noticia/83489/ja-shan-administrat-les-primeres-dosis-de-la-vacuna (''Periòdic d'Andorra'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal]]
****[[Portugal]] reports a record 14,647 new confirmed cases and 219 deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide totals to 581,605 confirmed cases and 9,465 deaths. [https://www.bloomberg.com/amp/news/articles/2021-01-20/portugal-reports-record-number-of-daily-new-coronavirus-cases (Bloomberg)] [https://sicnoticias.pt/especiais/coronavirus/2021-01-20-Portugal-regista-novos-maximos-diarios-de-mortes-e-casos-de-covid-19-1 (SIC Notícias)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****The [[Russian Direct Investment Fund]] files the registration of the [[Sputnik V]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] with the [[European Medicines Agency]] with the first review expected in February. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2021/01/20/russia-files-for-sputnik-vaccine-registration-in-eu-a72674 (''The Moscow Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****[[Spain]] reports a record 41,576 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 2,412,318. [https://www.eldiario.es/sociedad/espana-bate-nuevo-record-diario-nuevos-41-576-casos-coronavirus-tasa-incidencia-736_1_6963356.html (elDiario.es)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[United Kingdom]] reports a record 1,820 deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 93,290. [https://www.itv.com/news/2021-01-20/covid-highest-number-of-uk-deaths-reported-on-a-single-day-since-the-outbreak-began (ITV)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[India]] begins exporting the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine]] to [[Bhutan]] and [[Maldives]]. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/bhutan-maldives-first-to-benefit-from-india-s-vaccine-maitri-101611127804320.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Indonesia]] reports a record 9,755 recoveries in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of recoveries to 763,703. [https://nasional.okezone.com/read/2021/01/20/337/2347781/rekor-9-755-sembuh-dari-covid-19-dalam-sehari (Okezone)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Lebanon]]
****[[Lebanon]] reports a record 61 new deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 2,084. [https://www.the961.com/lebanon-4332-covid-64-deaths/amp/ (The961)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****The [[Government of Japan|government]] reaches an agreement with [[Pfizer]] for an additional 12 million doses of their [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2021/01/20/national/science-health/japan-agrees-pfizer-virus-vaccine-72-million-people/ (''The Japan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****[[Beijing]] impose a partial [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] in five neighbourhoods after two cases in [[Daxing district|Daxing]] were linked to B.1.1.7 variant found in the [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/partial-lockdown-in-beijing-as-uk-virus-variant-detected-01611141604 (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****The [[Philippines]] surpasses 10,000 deaths from COVID-19. [https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/news/nation/772537/philippines-covid-19-caseload-hits-505-939-as-death-toll-tops-10-000/story/ (GMA News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kenya]], [[501.V2 variant]]
****Acting Health Director-General Patrick Amoth confirms the first cases of the variant found in South Africa. The patients are two people who had traveled to that country. [https://www.kenyans.co.ke/news/61331-kenya-records-2-cases-new-covid-19-strain (Kenyans.co.ke)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Zimbabwe]]
****[[Zimbabwe]]'s [[Ministry of Regional Integration and International Cooperation (Zimbabwe)|International Trade]] and [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Zimbabwe)|Foreign Minister]] [[Sibusiso Moyo (politician)|Sibusiso Moyo]] dies due to complications from COVID-19. [https://www.news24.com/news24/southafrica/news/zimbabwes-foreign-minister-sb-moyo-dies-20210120 (News24)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[President of the United States|President]] [[Joe Biden]] signs an executive order mandating face masks on [[Federal lands|federal property]] and during interstate travel. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-biden-masks-idUSKBN29P2G5 (Reuters)]
***The [[United States]] reports a record 4,409 deaths in the past 24 hours. [https://www.ft.com/content/d01ff311-c997-4d12-bfc8-4685e0c01ec2 (''Financial Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Chile]]
***[[Chile]] approves the [[CoronaVac]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] developed by [[Sinovac]] for emergency use in the country. [https://medicalxpress.com/news/2021-01-chile-chinese-coronavirus-vaccine.html (MedicalXpress)]
*[[2020–21 H5N8 outbreak]]
**[[Iraq]] reports an outbreak of highly pathogenic [[H5N8]] [[Avian influenza|bird flu]] in the city of [[Samarra]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-birdflu-iraq/iraq-reports-h5n8-bird-flu-outbreak-on-farm-oie-idUSKBN29P1MM (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[China–United States relations]]
**The [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China|Chinese foreign ministry]] places sanctions on 28 members of the outgoing [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]], including former [[United States Secretary of State|Secretary of State]] [[Mike Pompeo]], former [[National Security Advisor (United States)|National Security Advisor]] [[John Bolton]], and former [[Counselor to the President|White House Chief Strategist]] [[Steve Bannon]]. The sanctions are believed to be in response to Pompeo's announcement on Tuesday that the [[Xinjiang re-education camps|internment of Muslim Uyghurs]] constitutes [[genocide]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-china-pompeo-blinken/china-imposes-sanctions-on-28-trump-era-officials-including-pompeo-idUSKBN29P14K?utm_source=reddit.com (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Presidency of Joe Biden]]
**[[Inauguration of Joe Biden]]
***[[Joe Biden]] is sworn in as the 46th [[President of the United States]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/av/world-us-canada-55740014 (BBC News)]
***[[Kamala Harris]] is sworn in as the 49th [[Vice President of the United States]], making her the first [[woman]], first [[Indian American]] in [[United States]] history to hold the office. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/kamala-harris-sworn-in/2021/01/20/a184a12e-5aa9-11eb-b8bd-ee36b1cd18bf_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
***[[Donald Trump]] becomes the first outgoing president to refuse to attend his successor's inauguration since [[Andrew Johnson]], who did not attend [[Ulysses S. Grant]]'s inauguration in 1869. [https://www.nytimes.com/2021/01/19/us/politics/presidents-who-skipped-inaugurations.html (''The New York Times'')]
**[[Cabinet of Joe Biden]]	
***The Senate votes to confirm [[Avril Haines]], Biden's nominee for [[Director of National Intelligence|United States Director of National Intelligence]] (DNI), 84-10. Haines is the first [[Political appointments by Joe Biden|Biden appointee]] to be confirmed by the [[United States Senate|Senate]], and the first woman to serve in the DNI. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/avril-haines-director-national-intelligence-senate-confirms/ (CBS News)]
**Biden signs [[List of executive actions by Joe Biden|his first executive orders]] reversing several Trump administration decisions, including rejoining the [[Paris Agreement]] and the [[World Health Organization]], repealing [[2017]] [[Trump travel ban|travel bans]], ending funding for the [[Trump wall|United States–Mexico border wall]], and revoking the permit for the [[Keystone Pipeline#Phase 4|Keystone XL pipeline]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-55738746 (BBC News)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/feature/nbc-out/biden-reverse-transgender-military-ban-imminently-white-house-says-n1254988?fbclid=IwAR2sPvvGIlJDc9JSarjHQ9eFauXDMQzBf95WzR-tjkfSbshEMIhBehZvSfQ (NBC News)] [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2021/jan/20/joe-biden-executive-orders-day-one (''The Guardian'')]
*[[117th United States Congress]]
**[[2020 United States Senate election in Georgia]], [[2020 United States Senate special election in Georgia]]
***[[Jon Ossoff]] and [[Raphael Warnock]] of [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]] are officially sworn in as Senators of the [[United States Senate]]. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2021/01/20/warnock-ossoff-sworn-in-giving-democrats-majority-senate/4217985001/ (''USA Today'')]
**[[Alex Padilla]] of [[California]] is officially sworn in as Senator of the [[United States Senate]], as an appointee replacing [[Kamala Harris]]. [https://www.latimes.com/politics/story/2021-01-20/alex-padilla-sworn-in-as-californias-first-latino-senator (''LA Times'')]
